name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-05-07, at wavelengths from 1.22 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
